Azerbaijani is the primary assistant language. Conversation history is encrypted on this device; recent context is sent to Gemini only with separate memory consent.

The text below will be sent to Google Gemini for a response. Your selected response language, tone, and level of detail are also sent; your profile name and time zone are not. Recent conversation and saved memory records are sent only when separate memory consent is enabled. Google may use free-service data to improve products.
No response. Check your connection and Firebase setup, then retry.
No response (%1$s). Check your connection and Firebase setup.
Conversation history is encrypted on this device and shared with the voice assistant.
Your messages will appear here when you start a conversation.
This removes saved voice and text conversation history from this device. Notes, people, finances, and tasks are unchanged.

To search memory, use tools, and continue earlier conversations, Memora may send only relevant memory records, tool results, and recent conversation messages to Google Gemini. The full archive is not sent. You can revoke permission at any time.
View and edit tables stored in your memory.
This row will be moved to the recoverable deleted list.
There are no rows in this view.
The action failed. No change was saved.
%1$d active rows will be merged into this same table. Existing rows and deleted-row history will not change.
This file contains the same read-only linked-view definition. Source records will not be copied or changed.
Speech for this language is unavailable on this device.
Speech uses your device text-to-speech engine, which may use the network.

The microphone sends audio to Google Gemini until stopped or the app leaves the foreground. Google may use free-service data to improve products. Your memory archive and tasks are not sent. Sessions are limited to one minute. Saving text requires a separate review. Consent is saved on this device and can be revoked in settings.
Microphone is on and audio is being sent to Google. You can speak.
Session ended. Start a new one to continue.
Voice conversation is unavailable. Check your connection and model availability, then try again.
Could not read or save settings. Try again; previous settings are not overwritten automatically.
Change permissions in Android settings. You can type without microphone access.
Permission does not guarantee delivery or sound: device modes and system restrictions also apply. After a change, open Tasks to reschedule future reminders.
Notification permission alone does not guarantee exact timing. Android’s “Alarms & reminders” access helps deliver reminders on time.
Could not open Android settings. Open the app settings manually.
A new version will be created. Previous text remains in history and exports.
Could not confirm the save. Retry or close and check the current text and history.
Versions are newest first. Times are UTC; device clock changes can make them differ from version order.
All local versions of this record will be deleted.
Add a note by voice or text.
Search sources saved on this device
No matching stored sources. Try a name or an exact phrase.
Information from confirmed records will appear here.
Notes and revisions are stored on this device. Sending to Google starts after your consent. Open Inbox for corrections and export.
Copyright and license terms for open-source components used by this application.
SQLCipher Community Edition uses LibTomCrypt; SQLite and LibTomCrypt are in the public domain. Other component licenses must be included with distribution materials.
Finish the current draft or wait for memory to load. No text was replaced.
Transcript limit reached. Session stopped; incomplete text cannot be saved as complete.
Record up to 25 seconds, then review and correct the transcript.

After consent, the microphone starts. The completed recording, up to 25 seconds, is sent to Google Gemini. Google also checks the writing system of the recognized text. Google may use free-service data to improve products. No audio file is saved; text is shown for review. Your memory archive is not sent. Consent is saved on this device and can be revoked in settings.
Writing system check failed. Review the original recognition carefully.
Check names, amounts and negation. Only the text you confirm will be saved.
Could not complete (%1$s). Try again; this code helps identify the issue.
Could not play audio. The answer is shown below.

With your consent, your voice and transcript are sent to Google Gemini. To produce speech, Google receives the answer, including the relevant name and amount. Your selected response language, tone, and level of detail are also sent; your profile name and time zone are not. Conversation history and saved memory records are sent only with separate memory consent. Google may use free-service data to improve products. Consent is saved on this device.
Swipe left to open the menu
Saved transfers, debts and original text. Delete an incorrect entry and say it again.
This record will be removed from memory.
The exported file is not encrypted and contains personal data. Store it securely.
Read current saved records directly. This view does not copy or edit them.
No active saved records match this view.

Example: Name:TEXT, Date:DATE, Amount:MONEY, Contact:PERSON_REF, Project:PROJECT_REF. Choose links from saved people and projects. Types: TEXT, INTEGER, DECIMAL, BOOLEAN, DATE, DATETIME, MONEY, PERSON_REF, PROJECT_REF.
Only new optional fields are added. Existing fields and rows stay unchanged. Example: Location:TEXT, Due date:DATE.
These new fields will be added. Existing fields and rows will remain unchanged.
Saved row values are not deleted. Values in fields absent from the schema stay hidden and may reappear if those fields are added again.
Local events and meetings. Ask the assistant to change an event.

Let’s keep the important things together.
Talk, think things through, and plan. Memora helps continue your conversations and saves only the information you ask it to remember.
Talk about a person, a debt, or a plan, then ask what was saved. These are examples only; nothing is stored.
Your name or preferred form of address

Search notes, saved facts and conversation history locally on this device.

The previous version kept only the latest 240 messages. From now on, history follows the retention period you choose.
Choose how long to keep conversations on this device. “Keep forever” disables automatic deletion.

Confirm deleting every conversation older than the selected period, including both sides of each turn. Its linked profile facts and episodic summaries will also be deleted; notes, people, finances and tasks will remain.
No matching saved notes or facts.
Only this summary will be deleted. Its source conversations will remain.

Linked to a saved source and revision

Your message is kept as a draft. If the previous request may have changed something, check before sending it again.
Help me correct or undo the previous action. Source: “%1$s”. Exact in-app record ID: %2$s. Change only this record; ask me first if anything is ambiguous.

An optional on-device briefing checks saved tasks, calendar events, and open cases. It sends no data to Google; notifications show no names, amounts, or private text. Set quiet-hour start and end to the same time to turn quiet hours off.

Notification permission was denied. The daily briefing remains off.
Enter the debug token created in Firebase Console for ai.memora.app. It is stored only on this phone. Keep this test token private and delete it from Console after testing.
This APK is not configured for a Firebase project.
Could not save the token on this phone.

Create or restore an encrypted copy of your local Memora database.
Use a password with at least 12 characters. Memora cannot recover it if you forget it.
The backup contains your local database and is encrypted with your password. Keep the file and password in a safe place.

This file is too large or its size cannot be verified.
This backup could not be authenticated or opened. Your current database was not changed.
Backup verified. It will replace the current local database.
Replacing will replace the current local Memora database with this backup. This cannot be undone from the app. Continue only if this is the backup you chose.
Password is incorrect or the backup is damaged. The current database was not changed.
Restore is prepared, but Memora could not restart automatically. Close and reopen the app before continuing.
